title: PersistFence's Drop can panic on a poisoned lock during unwinding, turning a test failure into a process abort
outcome: PersistFence::drop never panics. A poisoned completion or scripted-clock lock during unwinding is tolerated, so the first panic's message reaches the test result instead of a 0xc0000409 abort.
acceptance: PersistFence's Drop can panic on a poisoned lock during unwinding, turning a test failure into a process abort is done
